title: Vanity Top Soap Dispenser Solid Brass 5 Oz | Matte Black | Brass & Glass Soap Dispensers | Allied Brass | Countertop Lotion Pump | Allied Brass
description:
Stop juggling bottles around the sink and keep soap within easy reach with a vanity top soap dispenser in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. This countertop soap dispenser (also called a lotion dispenser or hand soap pump) is sized for everyday bathroom use and styled to match transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose enduring hardware made with solid brass and brass construction
- Coordinate easily with versatile bath accessories from the Brass & Glass Soap Dispensers collection
- Finish flexibility for matching faucets and accessories with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Details:
- Product type: Vanity top soap dispenser / countertop soap dispenser / lotion dispenser
- Use: Soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer
- Material: Solid brass (brass construction)
- Mounting/location: Vanity top / countertop (counter-mount style)
- Capacity: 5 oz
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in x 7 in x 5 in
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 in x 6 in x 4 in
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
